description: Source file implementing utility functions for mTLS support and state red support checks, including functions to determine if state red is supported, if device is in state red, and to retrieve mTLS certificates.

methods.name: isStateRedSupported
methods.description: Checks if state red support is present by verifying the presence of a specific support file.

methods.name: isInStateRed
methods.description: Determines if the device is currently in state red based on support and flag file presence.

methods.name: getMtlscert
methods.description: Retrieves mTLS certificate and key information; implementation varies based on compile-time flags.
